owner_system: The receiving venue (journal, conference, or preprint server) — owned by neither this repo nor suengj-com.

surface_decides: citation and reference formatting required by the venue
submission format, length limits, and peer-review process
core_decides: evidence burden, verification, and voice fit up to the point of hand-off

constraints.citation_style: formal, full bibliographic citation — not suengj-com's inline-link convention
constraints.register: formal, hedged claims stated precisely; no first-person voice unless the venue's convention allows it
constraints.length_hint: set by the venue; typically longer than any suengj-com content type
constraints.freshness: no 30-day freshness rule; academic review timelines are long by design and the content-type profile's freshness rule (if any) does not transfer

publication_boundary: Publication authority belongs entirely to the venue's own review process; neither this repo nor suengj-com holds any publication authority over this surface.

replaceable.note: Any academic venue with a compatible citation and submission-format profile can be substituted.
